description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.



About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

- Dairy and non-dairy toppings

- Premium fruit preparations

- Chocolate products

- Bakery creams and margarine compounds

- Flavor sauces

- Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: February 11, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore;
as such, major industryleaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills;
    fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel;
    candidates are requiredto have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

description:

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Um desenvolvedor é responsável por escrever código eficiente, resolver problemas técnicos de alta complexidade com autonomia, e colaborar ativamente com outros desenvolvedores do time para a entrega de soluções. Também é desejável a participação em mentorias dos analistas plenos júniores.

- Experiência sólida em Java (8+ ou superior).

- Experiência com APIs REST, microsserviços e integração de sistemas.

- Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade (bancário/financeiro é diferencial).

- Versionamento com Git e CI/CD.


Diferenciais:

- Noções de segurança da informação (OAuth2, JWT, LGPD).

- Experiência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).


Modelo: hibrido, sendo de 3x presenciais por semana em SP.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista Tributário Sênior
description:

Este profissional será responsável por analisar e gerenciar questões tributárias, elaborar planejamentos fiscais, garantir conformidade com a legislação vigente, realizar apuração de tributos e preparar declarações fiscais. A função inclui monitorar regulamentos fiscais, identificar oportunidades de economia tributária. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

  • Planejamento e Conformidade Tributária: Conhecimento aprofundado em planejamento tributário para otimizar a carga tributária da empresa e assegurar conformidade com a legislação.
  • Preparação de Tributos: Habilidade em preparar e revisar impostos, incluindo declarações fiscais precisas dentro dos cronogramas regulatórios.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidades analíticas sólidas para avaliar e interpretar legislação tributária e identificar oportunidades de otimização tributária.
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência em temas tributários complexos, como regimes especiais de tributação ou internacional, bem como inglês avançado ou fluente. Formação em ciências contábeis, direito ou áreas correlatas será valorizada.



EXPERIENCIA

  • Prestação de consultoria contábil/fiscal às empresas clientes da empresa contratante
  • Analise de folhas de pagamento – incidência de INSS
  • Auditoria de recolhimentos ao INSS e apuração de créditos sobre verbas indenizatórias da folha de pagamento, bem como, aproveitamento dos créditos via compensação, imputando os créditos nos sistemas da Receita: DCTFWeb, PER/DCOMP
  • Consultoria sobre folha de pagamento e recolhimentos previdenciários.
  • Auditoria e apuração de créditos de PIS/COFINS em empresas do SIMPLES NACIONAL, LUCRO PRESUMIDO e LUCRO REAL
  • Auditoria e apuração de Tributos Federais
  • Planejamento Estratégico Tributário
  • Estratégia fiscal para Holding familiares, adminsitrativas e empresariais
  • Consultoria Fiscal/contabil para empresas


REQUISITOS

  • Conhecimento em PERD/ECOMP e DECTFWEB
  • Conhecimento técnico com relação a REVISÕES DE PIS/COFINS
  • Conhecimento técnico com relação a apuração de PIS/COFINS com exclusão do ICMS de sua base de cálculos e aproveitamento do crédito oriundo de tal exclusão
  • Conhecimento técnico com relação à apuração de PIS/COFINS sobe produtos monofásicos.
  • Ensino Superior em Ciências Contábeis. Experiência profissional nas atividades a serem desenvolvidas.


Qualificações

  • Conformidade e Preparação Fiscal: É necessário possuir experiência em conformidade fiscal e preparação de declarações de impostos.
  • Demonstrações Financeiras e Contabilidade: Deve ter conhecimentos sólidos em elaboração de demonstrações financeiras e práticas contábeis.
  • Além das habilidades acima, será considerado um diferencial a certificação profissional em contabilidade e experiência prévia em empresas de consultoria tributária.

title: Líder De Equipe Comercial Externo - Mercado Pago -Paraná
description:

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.

Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the Job

We're looking for a Collections Agent to join our Operations Team. As a Collections Agent you will be responsible for executing hands-on collections activities to ensure timely recovery of overdue payments while maintaining professional relationships with SME customers. You will work directly with active cases, contacting customers and following up on overdue payments. The role plays a key part in reducing early-stage delinquency and supporting healthy cash flow across Credix’s portfolio.


Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • The ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with basic data (SQL), Excel, internal tools, and spreadsheets.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.
  • Collaborative mindset work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in fintech, operations, or financial services.


Responsibilities

  • Contact customers according to defined schedules and scripts via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • Develop and utilize communication scripts to negotiate.
  • Follow up on overdue payments and payment promises, ensuring timely actions aligned with the delinquency cycle (e.G., DPD+3, DPD+7).
  • Provide repayment options to improve the borrower experience.
  • Accurately log all payment information, customer interactions, agreements, and outcomes in internal systems.
  • Support the team with day-to-day operational tasks related to collections.
  • Escalate cases per internal policies and flag recurring issues, customer objections, or process gaps to the Collections Specialist.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions, generating actionable insights to improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using tools like SQL to identify inefficiencies and implement workflows that improve process efficiency.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Degree in Information technology, Engineering, or related field;
  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Java Developer;
  • Experience withSpringBoot;
  • Experience withTerraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL, GitHub, Azure Cloud;
  • Experience withKotlin;
  • Fluency in English (B2+ mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee– our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and teambuilding activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: on-site, hybrid or remote in Portugal.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Responsabilidades

  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas, elétricas e eletrônicas, propondo soluções ágeis e eficazes.

  • Conhecimentos em mecânica, elétrica e eletrônica básica .
  • Habilidade para leitura de manuais técnicos (em português e preferencialmente inglês).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com marcas como JACK, GETEX, JUKI, BROTHER, SIRUBA, SUNSTAR , entre outras.

  • Experiência anterior COMPROVADA em assistência técnica ou indústria têxtil.


Benefícios

  • Salário negociável de acordos com as competências do profissional, sempre compatível com o mercado.
  • Vale-transporte
  • Vale-refeição.
  • Plano de saúde após período de experiência. (90 dias)
  • Celular Corporativo
  • Treinamentos contínuos e oportunidade de crescimento na empresa.


Etapas do processo:

  1. Teste prático de regulagem de painel em máquinas automáticas (filigranas e bordadeiras).
  2. Teste prático de regulagem mecânica de máquinas de ponto fixo
  3. Teste prático de regulagem mecânica de máquinas ponto corrente
  4. Teste prático de regulagem de sistemas de corte de linhas de diversos modelos atuais.
  5. Teste prático de conhecimentos básicos de pneumática.
  6. Teste prático de conhecimentos em elétrica.
  7. Teste prático de comandos elétricos, incluindo relés, contatoras, disjuntores e solenoides.


Importante:

A participação e o cumprimento de todas as etapas do processo seletivo são obrigatórios. A ausência ou não realização de qualquer uma das fases implicará automaticamente na desclassificação do candidato.


Período de experiência:

O candidato aprovado passará por um período inicial de experiência de 30 dias, conforme previsto na CLT, podendo ser prorrogado até o limite legal de 90 dias. Durante esse período, serão avaliados os seguintes critérios:

  • Pontualidade, assiduidade e comprometimento.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado e adaptação.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.
  • Cumprimento de normas de segurança e procedimentos internos.
  • Postura profissional no atendimento a clientes e parceiros.

title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required;
    Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.G., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.G., FIDC) preferred


Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Description

The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 21,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 4.6bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.Com and follow us @HexagonAB.


Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops fleet management solutions for manned and unmanned operation for open pit mining. The solutions integrate in-vehicle, on prem and cloud components to improve the mining operation productivity and safety. The software developer will join a team that contributes to Hexagon’s fleet management solutions, primarily in the development of test and deployment infrastructure


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and support functionality and components of the fleet management solution offering.
  • Collaborate closely with the backend, frontend, firmware, and DevOps development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Develop Deployment and Testing Infra of the solutions
  • Bring innovative ideas for further development.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
  • Professional experience in software development.
  • Experience with .NET/C#, backend development, RESTful API, web frontends (React/JS/HTML/CSS).
  • Experience with Linux and Docker.
  • Experience with Git and agile development processes (e.G. Scrum, SAFe).
  • Full professional English proficiency.
  • Team oriented and able to work independently.
  • Positive working attitude and good general common sense to understand business requirements in mining.
  • Willing to travel to company’s offices and customer visits overseas occasionally.


Desirable:

  • Experience with Python.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with continuous integration and test automation.
  • Background on game development


Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


Travel Requirements:

5-10% of the time


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

We are building a very strong team comprised of high caliber professionals that will work closely with the client’s IT and Business stakeholders to deliver impactful programs.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects with talented colleagues in an international environment while developing your domain knowledge working for a top company.


Work Location: Work model in hybrid in Madrid (3 days at the office, 2 WFH),

Important note: This position requires relocation to Madrid, Spain. While the relocation is being arranged, the selected candidate will work remotely following Spanish business hours (CET). Once in Madrid, the role will be hybrid, combining on-site and remote work days.


Main tasks and accountabilities will be:

  • Lead end-to-end design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across multiple instances, with emphasis on core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management) and enterprise-wide integrations.
  • Develop and optimise custom applications, workflows, and automation using Flow Designer, Business Rules, UI Actions, Client Scripts, and GlideAjax, ensuring alignment with ITIL v3/v4 best practices.
  • Configure and enhance the ServiceNow Service Portal and customer-facing interfaces, utilising JavaScript and AngularJS to deliver intuitive user experiences.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with external systems via REST/SOAP web services, MID Server, and Integration Hub, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange in compliance with audit and segregation-of-duties requirements.

What do we expect from you?

  • Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, with proven involvement in full lifecycle implementations.
  • Certification(s): Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or System Administrator
  • Understanding of ITIL v3/v4 frameworks and their practical application within ServiceNow.
  • Deep expertise in core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request)
  • Experience in additional modules considered advantageous, e.G. Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Proficient in server-side and client-side scripting : o GlideAjax, Business Rules, UI Actions, Client Scripts o JavaScript knowledge, including Service Portal scripting with AngularJS


What can we offer?

  • 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
  • Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).
  • Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)

  • Professional stability and career plans
  • UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
  • The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
  • Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
  • UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades. Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!

description:
Comece aqui. Veja onde pode chegar.


Curitiba - PR


No Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Nós compartilhamos ideias e perspectivas para, juntas e juntos, podermos desenvolver soluções que entreguem uma vida mais agradável e sustentável.


Venha e junte-se a nós como você é, porque acreditamos que pontos de vista diversos nos tornam mais fortes e inovadores. Dentro da nossa comunidade global com pessoas de mais de cem países, nós ouvimos uns aos outros, e ativamente colaboramos e crescemos em diversidade e inclusão.


Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!


Tudo sobre a função:


Aqui no Electrolux Group, nós vamos muito mais além da melhoria contínua, e isso inclui desafiar nossos próprios processos de trabalho. Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. Atuando de maneira dinâmica, ágil e focada na satisfação do consumidor, as nossas equipes de Produção contribuem para garantir que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação em produtos e serviços.


O que você vai fazer:


Seu maior desafio será liderar o time de operadores de Manufatura, garantindo os recursos necessários para o atendimento da programação de produção diária sem perder o foco na segurança de sua equipe e nos elevados padrões de qualidade da Electrolux. Se você tem boa capacidade de organização e análise, facilidade para se comunicar e colaborar, e consegue unir a sua visão estratégica com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar entregando experiências extraordinárias, e nós vamos te ajudar a voar muito mais alto.


Algumas responsabilidades serão:


- Treinar os membros da equipe, capacitando eles para suas funções conforme as metodologias e procedimentos internos da empresa;

- Continuamente buscar a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, a fim de obter melhores resultados;

- Lidar com procedimentos diários como controle de ponto, atestados médicos, distribuição de tarefas e turnos de trabalho, entre outros;

- Atuar na prevenção de acidentes de trabalho, monitorando o seguimento das Regras de Ouro de Segurança;

- Motivar a equipe, reduzindo o absenteísmo e o turnover de funcionários, e melhorando os resultados de Segurança, Qualidade, Entrega, Custo e Pessoas, sempre assegurando que todos estão trabalhando de acordo com os valores da Electrolux;

- Utilizar o EMS (Sistema de Manufatura Electrolux), baseado nas ferramentas e princípios de Lean Manufacturing.


Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).


Quem é você:


Você tem:


- Superior Completo e/ou Pós-Graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia ou áreas Tecnológicas voltadas à indústria ou afins;

- Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes (mínimo de 30 pessoas);

- Experiência comrotinas e processos de linha de produção e/ou montagem de produtos;

- Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua com base na aplicação das técnicas e princípios do Lean Manufacturing;

- Conhecimento nas ferramentas da indústria 4.0;

- Desejável experiência e conhecimento em legislações aplicáveis em gestão de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em empresas de grande porte;

- Pacote Office intermediário;

- Desejável Inglês intermediário.


Onde você vai estar:


Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.


Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:


- Descontos nos produtos e serviços da Electrolux;

- Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;

- Acesso ao Gympass;

Como parte do Electrolux Group, vamos investir continuamente em você e no seu desenvolvimento. Não existem barreiras para onde sua carreira pode te levar.

- Atuar como principal ponto focal técnico e gerencial perante o cliente, mantendo comunicação clara, tempestiva e estruturada em todas as fases do projeto, fortalecendo relações de confiança e garantindo o correto entendimento das necessidades e expectativas.

- Gerenciar integralmente o escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, riscos e recursos dos projetos, aplicando metodologias consolidadas de gerenciamento (PMI, PMBOK, Agile adaptado a engenharia, ou similares), garantindo entregas dentro dos padrões acordados.

- Coordenar o desenvolvimento técnico junto a equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia sanitária, hidráulica, ambiental, civil, geotecnia, topografia, BIM, orçamento e planejamento), garantindo integração entre disciplinas e consistência técnica entre os produtos entregues.

- Acompanhar a evolução física e financeira dos projetos, realizando reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com líderes de equipe, identificando desvios, implementando ações corretivas e comunicando riscos antecipadamente ao cliente e à direção interna.

- Gerenciar o contrato de forma estratégica: acompanhar termos, escopo contratado, aditivos, medição de serviços, fluxo de entregáveis, negociação de pleitos e suporte direto às áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações quanto a compliance e obrigações contratuais.

- Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos entregues por atenderem os desempenhos operacionais e econômicos requeridos pelas boas práticas e pelas Normas Técnicas brasileiras produzidas pela ABNT ou na falta delas normas ASTM ou ISO e diretrizes das Concessionárias, as normas ambientais e de segurança aplicáveis.

- Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e apresentações executivas para direção e clientes, consolidando status de projeto, risco, indicadores de desempenho, decisões pendentes e planos de ação.

- Mapear oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções técnicas, otimizações de processo, inovações e uso de tecnologias (BIM, SIG, modelagem hidráulica, automação de processos) para aumentar eficiência e agregar valor ao cliente.

- Representar tecnicamente a empresa em reuniões, workshops e visitas a campo, garantindo visão integrada das condições reais do sistema e alinhamento entre projeto, execução e necessidades operacionais.

- Promover um ambiente colaborativo, orientando equipes, fomentando boas práticas de gestão e assegurando comunicação fluida entre todas as disciplinas e partes envolvidas.

Formação & Qualificações

- Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Sanitária ou áreas correlatas.

- Registro profissional ativo (CREA).

- Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Saneamento, Infraestrutura ou Gestão Empresarial (desejável).

- Certificações como PMP, CAPM, Prince2, Scrum Master ou similares são diferenciais valorizados em gerenciamento de projetos de engenharia.


Experiência Profissional:


- Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerenciamento de projetos de saneamento, incluindo:

– sistemas de abastecimento de água

– esgotamento sanitário

– redes, adutoras e coletores

– ETEs, ETAs, elevatórias

– obras de infraestrutura associadas


- Vivência em empresas de engenharia, consultoria, concessionárias de água/esgoto ou projetos públicos.

- Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares (hidráulica, civil, ambiental, geotecnia, BIM etc.).

- Histórico na gestão completa do ciclo de vida de projetos: planejamento, execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.

- Experiência em análise de contratos, aditivos, pleitos, medição e interface com clientes públicos e privados.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

- Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos:

– MS Project

– Pacote Office (Excel avançado)

– ferramentas de controle de indicadores (Power BI é diferencial)


- Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas técnicas:

– AutoCAD

– softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, SEWERGEMS, WaterGEMS)

– BIM (Revit, Navisworks, ou familiaridade com metodologia)


- Conhecimento atualizado sobre:

– normas ABNT/NBR aplicáveis ao saneamento

– diretrizes técnicas de concessionárias (Sabesp, Copasa, Sanepar, BRK, Aegea etc.)

– legislações ambientais e regulatórias

– requisitos de licenciamento ambiental (LP, LI, LO)


Competências Comportamentais:

title: Data Scientist
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and technically strong Data Scientist to support high-impact analytical initiatives across finance, strategy, pricing, and commercial functions. This role works directly with the Head of Strategy, and senior commercial leaders to shape business decisions through rigorous analytics, AI-driven insights, and a deep understanding of complex product and channel environments. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical excellence, business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes across a diverse set of stakeholders.

What you'll do

Strategic Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a core analytical partner to the CFO, Head of Strategy, and commercial leadership, helping define analytical priorities and shaping strategic decision-making.
  • Translate evolving business needs into robust analytical plans, ensuring clarity around objectives, data requirements, and expected impact.

Advanced Analytics & Data Science Execution

  • Develop predictive models, segmentation frameworks and optimization analyses to support financial planning, portfolio strategy, and commercial performance.
  • Build and refine scalable analytics workflows in SQL and Google BigQuery, ensuring high-quality data pipelines and efficient processing of large datasets.
  • Apply AI and machine learning techniques to automate processes, enhance decision-making, and unlock new insights across pricing, customer behavior, and product performance.

Revenue, Pricing & Growth Insights

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses into revenue drivers, product mix, elasticity, promotions, and customer/segment profitability.
  • Support revenue management or growth initiatives by identifying leverage points for price optimization, margin enhancement, sales acceleration, and product strategy.
  • Evaluate performance across complex or configurable product portfolios, ensuring insights account for multivariate product and commercial structures.

Business Communication & Influence

  • Synthesize analytical findings into clear, concise narratives tailored for executives and commercial teams.
  • Help build a data-driven culture by elevating analytical standards, sharing best practices, and improving access to insights.


Who you are

  • 5+ years in data science, advanced analytics, revenue management, pricing analytics, or growth-focused analytical roles.
  • Deep expertise in SQL and Google BigQuery, with hands-on experience managing large, complex datasets.
  • Proven track record partnering with finance leaders, strategy leaders, or senior commercial executives.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to proactively identify high-value analytics and AI opportunities.
  • Experience with complex product portfolios, configurable/custom products, or multi-category commercial environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing AI-driven methods within data science workflows.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to align technical insights to business priorities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing (Required)
  • Previous experience supporting teams globally with a focus on North America (Preferred)
  • Experience with pricing analytics, elasticity modeling, promotional analysis, or revenue optimization. (Preferred)
  • Prior work in growth, revenue strategy, commercial analytics, or similar functions. (Preferred)
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or comparable languages for advanced modeling. (Preferred)

What's in it for you

  • Annual base salary range: BRL 235,000 - 319,000
  • Bonus target range: 25%
  • Enjoy our Flexible Time Off (FTO) program designed to support work–life balance (excludes new hires in Illinois).
  • Generous benefits package
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development and professional growth

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Company Description

Holy Koolaid is a YouTube channel dedicated to science, skepticism, and critical thinking . The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .


Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects
  • Can work with fast-paced YouTube content
  • Has the resilience and independence to figure things out and solve problems


How to Apply

Please include:

  • Portfolio or demo reel
  • Examples of motion graphics or animation work
  • Examples of video editing projects
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in this role

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.

title: Especialista De Governanca De Dados
description:

Estamos procurando um Especialista de Governanca de dados


Responsabilidades:

● Desenvolvimento de Estruturas (Frameworks): Projetar e implementar o framework de governança de dados, incluindo políticas, padrões, processos e diretrizes.

● Gestão de Dados Mestres (MDM): Liderar ou participar ativamente de iniciativas de MDM para garantir uma fonte única e confiável para os dados críticos da empresa (clientes, produtos, fornecedores).

● Qualidade de Dados: Definir métricas de qualidade de dados (Data Quality), estabelecer processos de monitoramento e liderar projetos para correção e melhoria contínua dos dados.

● Catálogo e Dicionário de Dados: Estruturar e manter o catálogo de dados corporativo, garantindo que a linhagem de dados, metadados de negócio e definições sejam claras e acessíveis.

● Papeis e Responsabilidades: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para definir e formalizar os papéis de Data Owners e Data Stewards, fornecendo treinamento e suporte.

● Capacitação e Letramento em Dados: Conduzir programas de capacitação, promovendo a cultura data-driven e elevando a maturidade de dados da organização.

● Modelo de Data Stewards: Estruturar, implementar e acompanhar o modelo de Data Stewards, promovendo engajamento, capacitação e responsabilidade nas áreas de negócio.

● Maturidade de Dados: Avaliar o nível de maturidade organizacional em dados, definir roadmaps de evolução e acompanhar a execução, garantindo que os dados sejam ativos estratégicos.

● Conformidade e Segurança: Assegurar que as práticas de gestão de dados estejam em conformidade com a LGPD e outras regulamentações, trabalhando em conjunto com as equipes de Segurança da Informação e Jurídico.

● Liderança e Influência: Atuar como uma autoridade no tema, orientando equipes de projeto, arquitetos e líderes de negócio sobre as melhores práticas de governança.

Diferenciais:


● Experiência no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: Financeiro, Varejo, Mineração).

● Conhecimento em ferramentas de governança em nuvem (ex: Azure Purview, GCP DataPlex, AWS Glue).

● Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de dados.

● Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Formação:

○ Superior completo e comprovado em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

○ Obrigatório: Pelo menos uma pós-graduação, MBA ou certificação avançada na área (ex: DAMA CDMP Practitioner/Master, CIMP). Certificações de nível fundamental (Associate) não cumprem este requisito.

Requisitos:


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

○ Domínio completo de todas as competências do nível Sênior.

○ Experiência comprovada na criação de business cases e na definição de ROI para iniciativas de governança.

○ Profundo conhecimento em arquiteturas de dados modernas e como a governança se aplica em ambientes Cloud e Big Data.

○ Liderança na implementação e gerenciamento de plataformas de MDM (multidomínio é um diferencial).

title: Technical Account Manager, Hybrid São Paulo
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.


We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.


HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets:


- Hotelbeds, who cater for the specific needs of hoteliers, tour operators, airlines and online travel agents


- Bedsonline, exclusively serving the retail travel segment


- Roiback, the HotelTech partner for independent hotels and chains seeking growth through direct channel solutions


- TravelStack, providing all products, services and solutions to businesses looking to enter into the lucrative travel arena.


Job Summary


We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a strong technology foundation and a proven ability to deliver strategic solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines technical expertise with customer-centric account management , ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and long-term success for our most strategic partners.

As a TAM, you will act as a trusted advisor , building strong relationships with key accounts, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across global teams. You will lead technical engagements, oversee API client optimization, and provide proactive solutions that align with business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.


Job Responsibilities


Territory Growth & Development

  • Partner with sales teams to position and deliver technical solutions to strategic customers through presentations, demos, evaluations, and technical objection handling.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key accounts, ensuring smooth communication and integration.
  • Maximize product adoption and distribution from a technical perspective .

Solution Delivery & Optimization

  • Lead all technical activities related to customer onboarding and API integrations.
  • Provide post-sales technical support , troubleshoot issues, and resolve complex cases.
  • Analyze client performance and define optimization strategies to drive efficiency and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to monitor, alert, and report on production environments.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to align technical requirements with business goals.
  • Participate in global and regional projects , ensuring timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation and ensure KPIs are consistently met.

Required Skills & Experience


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering , or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Strategic Technical Account Manager or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML, JSON , and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Databases & SQL .
  • Understanding of automation practices across development, build, and deployment phases.
  • Familiarity with build management and CI/CD tools .
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, maintainable documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills , initiative, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience in the Travel Industry is a plus.
  • ADVANCED ENGLISH is a must

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Global Hrbp
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.


Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.


Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.


2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.G., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.


3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.


4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.


5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.


Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.


Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.


Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.


What We Offer

- A 6-to-12-month foundational rotation at Beijing Headquarters, connecting you with the core of our business and setting the stage for long-term success.

- A platform at the forefront of international growth, where your contributions directly impact our core strategy.

- Accelerated career growth by solving complex, real-world business challenges from day one.

- An environment of trust and autonomy that encourages bold thinking and innovation.

title: Analista De Customer Service Pleno (Temporário) – Mercado Doméstico
description:
Você tem perfil organizado, gosta de atendimento ao cliente e busca uma oportunidade em uma empresa de grande porte do setor alimentício?

A Claire Joster está recrutando para uma posição temporária (com possibilidade de efetivação) como Analista de Customer Service Pleno. A vaga é para atuar no mercado doméstico de uma renomada indústria de embalagens.

Se você tem graduação em Administração ou áreas correlatas, domínio do Pacote Office e está pronto para lidar com a gestão de pedidos, emissão de documentos e relacionamento com clientes, essa pode ser a chance de dar um próximo passo na sua carreira.


Sobre a Empresa:

Indústria de embalagens para o setor alimentício, reconhecida pela qualidade de seus produtos e pelo compromisso com a satisfação dos clientes.


Modalidade de Contratação: Temporário (com possibilidade de efetivação)

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 às 18:00

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo (Região)

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Escolaridade: Graduação completa em Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Domínio do Pacote Office, com foco em Excel avançado e Power BI para análise de demanda

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Espanhol


Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar a gestão da carteira de clientes, com foco na resolução de problemas, dúvidas e reclamações técnicas
  • Efetuar follow-up de pedidos (E2E) e interface direta com Logística, Supply Chain, Crédito e Cobrança
  • Cadastrar pedidos e acompanhar o fluxo de produção via Pending Orders, atento ao Service Level para atender os clientes com eficiência
  • Emitir e conferir documentos de exportação, incluindo a DANFE
  • Cadastrar e acompanhar reclamações, devoluções, análises de artes e compensações
  • Cadastrar novos clientes com todas as informações necessárias para o correto faturamento
  • Preparar relatórios mensais pertinentes à área de atuação
  • Realizar follow-up semanal com cada cliente e reportar ao gestor as informações tratadas
  • Enviar semanalmente a posição financeira para cada cliente, apontando possíveis pendências
  • Acompanhar o andamento de cada processo de exportação, garantindo a realização do embarque
  • Participar de reuniões triangulares (vendedor, técnico e cliente) para melhorar a comunicação e o atendimento


Sobre o Processo Seletivo:

A Claire Joster é a consultoria responsável pelo recrutamento e seleção para esta posição. Os candidatos selecionados serão contatados para dar seguimento ao processo.

title: Coordenador(A) De Turno
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Missão do Cargo:

Responder pela coordenação e planejamento das atividades pertinentes à fabricação do produto em seu turno de trabalho, a fim de assegurar a melhoria contínua no desenvolvimento das pessoas e dos processos.


Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar e acompanhar a operação da linha tomando ações corretivas e preventivas sempre que necessário.
  • Garantir que as atividades executadas sob sua responsabilidade sejam realizadas conforme as normas de segurança, saúde, meio ambiente e qualidade.
  • Analisar os indicadores das linhas de operação e propor iniciativas para aqueles que estiverem com desvio.
  • Participar da elaboração e apoiar a área de manutenção nas paradas semanais, mensais e anuais.
  • Realizar análise e liberação de PT e ART como liberadores de área.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos programas de segurança para colaboradores próprios e terceiros quando necessário.
  • Participar e incentivar a utilização das ferramentas da qualidade/ melhoria contínua conforme procedimentos e políticas da empresa.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Produção ou áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Experiência na área industrial;
  • Experiência em gestão de processos e de equipes;
  • Experiência comliderança em linhas de produção
  • Conhecimento em SAP e sistema de produção;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas da qualidade;
  • Disponibilidadede horário para trabalhar em turnos;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalhar em Ponta Grossa/PR;
  • Desejável conhecimento do processo produtivo de linhas de MDF, BP’s e impregnadoras.

Nosso time é movido por desafios, inovação e aquele brilho nos olhos de quem sabe que tá fazendo história. Já pensou fazer parte de algo gigante assim?

Aqui, sua carreira pode crescer tanto quanto a gente. Bora?


Conheça o nosso manifesto:

O mundo é movido por pessoas que fazem acontecer.

Fazer acontecer é uma maneira de viver.

Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.

Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças.

Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação.

É nisso que acreditamos. Essa é a nossa essência.

Chegamos até aqui porque cremos em nossos resultados e no nosso propósito de descomplicar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma liderança forte, visão audaciosa, cultura inspiradora e uma equipe composta de pessoas incríveis, formamos uma empresa pungente que pensa no coletivo.

Afinal, se um ganha, todos ganham.

Nossa ambição é grandiosa.

Prazer. Somos o Chaves na Mão.


Quais são os nossos valores?

Fazemos do nosso jeito: Somos ousados e não tememos trilhar nosso caminho da nossa maneira.

O bife vira: Não desistimos no primeiro obstáculo e cremos sempre que vamos virar o jogo.

Curtimos a jornada: Curtimos a escalada rumo ao topo entendendo que pessoas felizes performam melhor.
